name: walkTo
description: Walk the vanilla path to a world position at a gait.

x.description: The target world x in tiles.

y.description: The target world y in tiles.

name: steer
description: Move along a world vector for a time, without a path, at a gait.

seconds.description: How long to steer in seconds.

name: attack
description: One swing at the target: done when the swing ends; read `result.attackStarted` and the target's health in the next frame; a target out of reach is approached first within the skill's budget, else `out of reach`.

name: interact
description: Open or close the door or window on a square, or loot its containers.

maxWeight.description: A loot stops before the carried weight would pass this; 0 for no cap.

name: equip
description: Equip an inventory item in the primary hand.

name: consume
description: Eat or drink an inventory item.

name: drop
description: Drop an inventory item on the player's square.

name: stop
description: Stop the current skill and every motor flag.

name: scan
description: Queue a full map scan of the squares within a radius.

hz.description: The frame rate in frames a second.

name: sleep
description: Sleep where the player stands until the engine wakes them.

name: aim
description: Hold the combat stance for a time, facing a zombie (targetId) or a bearing, while walking along a world vector (zero to stand): the backpedal. The stance walks only and never swings by itself; an attack sent while it holds swings from it. Released at its end, by any other skill (a walk or a climb cannot run in it) and when the target dies.

vx.description: The world vector's x component (0 with vy 0 to stand).

seconds.description: How long to hold the stance in seconds.

targetId.description: The zombie's online id to face each tick; -1 to face the bearing instead.

bearing.description: The world bearing to face in degrees (0 east, 90 south), used when targetId is -1; -1 keeps the current facing.

name: climb
description: Climb the hoppable fence on a square's north or west edge at a walk (never a vault): a walk to the near side, then vanilla's climb; a tall fence fails 1 time in s.

x.description: The fence square's x (the square whose hopN or hopW reads true).

name: bandage
description: Bandage a body part with a held bandage, ripped sheet or rag (vanilla's ISApplyBandage; a bandage already on the part is taken off first). A dirty rag stops the bleeding but doubles the infection odds.

part.description: The body part index; -1 for the worst: a bleeding unbandaged part (a deep wound first, then the longest bleeding time), else a wound under a dirty bandage, else an unbandaged wound.

name: rip
description: Rip a held, unworn cotton garment into rags with no tool (vanilla's RipClothing craft): refused worn, needs tool (denim, leather) or not cotton.

name: wash
description: Wash a held dirty rag or bandage clean at the water source on a square (a walk next to it, then vanilla's ISWashClothing; soap optional, the water's taint untested).
